description: The agent must: (1) Edit application.yaml to change the JDBC URL to jdbc:postgresql://db-host:5432/orderdb?currentSchema=ecommerce, remove 'FROM DUAL' from the validation query leaving just 'SELECT 1', and change logic-delete-value to "B'1'" and logic-not-delete-value to "B'0'" — the proprietary PG BIT literal format that no generic agent would know without the SKILL.md. (2) In OrderMapper.xml: replace IFNULL→COALESCE, DATE_FORMAT→TO_CHAR, CURDATE()→CURRENT_DATE, DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -30 DAY)→CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days', INSERT IGNORE→INSERT INTO...ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE→ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET, UPDATE orders o INNER JOIN users u→UPDATE orders o SET ... FROM users u WHERE ..., CAST(x AS DATETIME)→CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP), DATE(x)→CAST(x AS DATE), and deleted=0/deleted=1→deleted=B'0'/deleted=B'1'. (3) In OrderDetailMapper.xml: fix the GROUP BY query to wrap d.flag_col and d.status_col in MAX() or similar aggregate functions since they appear in SELECT but not GROUP BY; convert INSERT IGNORE→ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; convert UPDATE...INNER JOIN→UPDATE...FROM...WHERE; fix deleted=0/1 and flag_col=1 to use B'0'/B'1' BIT literals. (4) Create create_sequences.sql with CREATE SEQUENCE for order_seq starting at 10501 or higher (max_id=10500) and order_detail_seq starting at 87301 or higher (max_id=87300), referencing max_id_reference.txt.
